abstract_html: Pardon’s integral curve-counting algebra has geometric generators whose local models may depend on the covering multiplicity. In first Chern number and virtual dimension zero we give a single model in each genus for all multiplicities. On a genus-g curve take two line bundles of degree g−1 with canonical determinant and act on them with opposite weights. The equivariant classes of the multiple zero sections freely generate the integral algebra. The comparison with an isolated holomorphic multiple is triangular in multiplicity, with leading coefficient one given by the complex orientation of the embedded curve. The resulting factors give a unique product with integral exponents for effective cycles of Chern number zero on every compact Kähler threefold whose first Chern class is nonnegative on curves.
